thread.title: Reuters: Apple's upcoming multiplayer AR will prioritize privacy - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Reuters: Apple's upcoming multiplayer AR will prioritize privacy - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) will debut tools allowing two iPhones to share AR while limiting personal data sent to servers, according to Reuters sources .
In comparison, Google’s multiplayer AR system requires a player to scan the environment and then upload the raw data to Google’s servers.
Earlier this week, Bloomberg sources had said that the new ARKit 2.0 software that should debut at WWDC would include the ability to share a virtual environment. But the Reuters information makes it more apparent that Apple has prioritized privacy in the tech.
WWDC kicks off on Monday.
Apple shares are up 1.6% to $189.83.
